summary: Build a realtime collaborative whiteboard web app with a catchy UI, organized as a single downloadable project folder suitable for GitHub publishing, and provide a working preview.

existing_features.title: Create a full whiteboard drawing experience in the React UI, including: freehand pen (variable stroke size), eraser, basic shapes (rectangle, ellipse, line/arrow), text tool, sticky notes, select/move/resize elements, undo/redo, zoom in/out, and pan.

Implement collaborative board sync using the Internet Computer backend canister so multiple users can work on the same board with near-real-time updates (polling-based updates, no WebSockets). Provide a board “Share Code / Link” mechanism to join the same board.

Add Internet Identity login and identity-aware collaboration features: show the signed-in user, show a simple participants list per board, and attribute updates to the user (display name fallback if no profile is set).
Add board management UX: a home screen with create/join board, a recent boards list (local to the browser), and an in-board top bar with board title rename, share button, and export actions.

Deliver a cohesive, catchy visual theme and apply it consistently across the app (home screen, whiteboard, toolbars, panels, dialogs). Theme must not rely on a default/unstyled look. Use a distinctive palette (avoid blue/purple by default), strong typography hierarchy, and polished spacing.

Provide a “working preview” in the form of a fully runnable project in a single repository folder with clear scripts and documentation: local dev run steps, local IC replica deploy steps, and production build steps suitable for pushing to GitHub and publishing.

Organize frontend code into clear folders (e.g., pages, components, canvas, tools, state, api) and backend code into well-named modules (if needed) while respecting the platform’s immutable frontend paths. Ensure the user can download a single folder containing all files needed to push to GitHub.

Add a board background/template feature with the following modes: Blank, Dots, Grid, and Lines. The selected background must be stored as part of the board’s metadata and loaded for all collaborators when they open/join the board.

Implement background rendering on the canvas for Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines. The background must render behind all elements and respect the viewport pan/zoom so the pattern appears “anchored” to the world space (i.e., it doesn’t slide relative to drawings when panning/zooming).

Add a “Create New Board” modal that lets the user enter a board name and select a template (Blank / Dots / Grid / Lines), matching the intent of the uploaded screenshots (template tiles + primary “Create Board” action). Creating the board navigates into that board with the selected template applied.

Add an in-board UI control to switch the board background between Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines (for example in the top bar overflow menu or a small settings dropdown). Changing it updates the board metadata so all collaborators converge to the new background.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a realtime collaborative whiteboard web app (drawing, collaboration, and core whiteboard tools).
Design a catchy, polished UI for the whiteboard app.
Provide a clear project folder/file structure so the app can be downloaded as a single folder and pushed to GitHub for publishing.
Provide a working preview/demo of the app (runnable build or deployable preview).

Implement backend data model and APIs in the single Motoko actor to support: creating boards, reading board snapshots, appending operations/events, incremental sync by version, and presence/heartbeat updates. Persist board state in canister stable memory across upgrades (no migration unless needed later).
Add whiteboard background modes (blank, dotted grid, lined/grid) with an in-app toggle.
Update the backend API and data model to include board metadata for background mode (and return it in snapshot/changes responses) without breaking existing board operations syncing.

projectName: Collaborative whiteboard app with near-real-time sync, Internet Identity, and polished UI
